native_carrier.name: FM27 Native Parent Snapshot (V0.9)
native_carrier.role: serialization carrier only; conceptual tactical parent is V1.1
native_carrier.inheritance: All 22 IP/OOP phases are explicitly written by V1.2. The four team instructions are explicitly retained at V1.1 values. Other unmentioned opaque sections inherit from the V0.9 native carrier.

changes.IP: All V1.1 IP slots, roles, duties, and PIs are retained: DL/DCL/DCR/DR remain the IP back four; DCL is the valid CentreBack/Defend role.

OOP.after: Compact four-back / 4-2-3-1 DM-style screen: DL-DCL-DCR-DR; DML-DMR; ML-MC-MR; AMC as the single high outlet
OOP.asymmetry: DR Holding Full-Back/Defend holds the right lane; DL Pressing Full-Back/Support is the selective wide presser.
OOP.central_cover: DCL Covering Centre-Back, DCR Centre-Back; DML Screening Defensive Midfielder; DMR Wide-Cover Defensive Midfielder; MC Screening Central Midfielder.
OOP.wide_cover: ML/MR Tracking Wide Midfielder/Defend, with selective More Often pressing and Tackle Harder.
OOP.front_outlet: ST slot becomes Splitting Outlet Attacking Midfielder/Attack at AMC, retaining one high outlet without an OOP ST.

OOP_PI.trigger_press: Less Often on DCR and DMR; DCL Covering Centre-Back has Less Often fixed-on; More Often on DL Pressing Full-Back (fixed-on), ML/MR tracking midfielders and AMC outlet.
OOP_PI.tackling: Tackle Harder is selective on DL, DMR, ML and MR; central covering defenders and screening DML/MC are not forced into the same override.
